items.title: American Medical Association CEO talks regulating AI care
items.excerpt: AMA CEO John Whyte warns against weak oversight as FDA races to set rules for AI medical devices, including generative AI tools that act on patients directly.

items.title: Healthcare industry weighs in on evidence standards for generative AI medical devices
items.excerpt: FDA is weighing evidence standards for generative AI medical devices such as prescription bots; AMA opposes accepting upfront uncertainty while ATA Action backs post-market monitoring.

items.title: Developers, not doctors, should be held accountable for generative AI medical devices, providers say
items.excerpt: Provider groups are lobbying the FDA to make tech companies responsible for the safety and performance of generative AI-backed medical devices, arguing makers are best equipped to evaluate them.

items.title: AMA Calls for Risk-Based GenAI Oversight to Protect Patients and Support Responsible Innovation
items.excerpt: As generative AI takes on more consequential clinical functions, the AMA urges FDA to settle who is responsible for keeping these tools safe once they enter clinical practice, via risk-based oversight.

items.title: FDA Official Believes GenAI-enabled Tools Will Need to Be Assessed Like a Physician
items.excerpt: FDA Digital Health Center of Excellence director Rick Abramson says generative AI devices behave 'more like me as a physician than a heart valve', signaling physician-style evaluation.

items.title: Sentara Health deploys new AI case management tool co-developed with Regard
items.excerpt: Sentara Health rolled out an AI case-management tool built with Regard that lets case managers query charts in plain language for discharge planning; it plans to expand into acute and ambulatory care, projecting ~90,000 hours saved.

items.title: Doximity adds UpToDate to Ask in push to become doctors' go-to AI platform
items.excerpt: Doximity partnered with Wolters Kluwer to embed UpToDate's evidence-based clinical content directly inside Doximity Ask, its AI clinical decision support tool for physicians.

items.title: Artificial intelligence checks the trustworthiness of breast cancer AI models
items.excerpt: University of Pittsburgh researchers built an uncertainty-weighted deep learning model for mammography that outputs a confidence score alongside each prediction, flagging cases where breast cancer AI may be unreliable.

items.title: Body composition changes on CT could signal pancreatic cancer years before diagnosis
items.excerpt: Mayo Clinic used an AI body-composition tool on routine abdominal CTs of 1,825 pancreatic cancer patients and 3,650 controls, finding steeper fat loss up to three years before diagnosis (Pancreatology).

items.title: CT tool may detect pulmonary fibrosis progression more than 2 years sooner
items.excerpt: Brainomix's FDA-cleared AI quantitative CT tool e-Lung flagged pulmonary fibrosis progression an average of 16 months (up to 28) before clinical diagnosis in 509 patients across three U.S. centers.

items.title: FDA clears Elucid's new AI-enabled FFR-CT software
items.excerpt: FDA cleared Elucid's AI-based FFR-IQ, which estimates fractional flow reserve from coronary CT angiography using plaque composition; it reported 92.2% sensitivity and 93.1% specificity, making Elucid the third U.S. FFR-CT vendor.

items.title: LLMs mostly avoid unnecessary care in Choosing Wisely tests
items.excerpt: In an Annals of Internal Medicine study, LLMs recommended potentially unnecessary care in about 5% of Choosing Wisely scenarios, but over 40% of responses recommended thyroid ultrasound for small incidental nodules.

items.title: Manual, DL-generated segmentations differ in radiomic features
items.excerpt: An AJR study from Cincinnati Children's found deep learning-generated segmentations on abdominal CT and MRI yield radiomic features with poor-to-fair agreement and bias versus manual segmentation.

items.title: “목 찍다 놓친 폐암, AI가 잡아낸다” 의료영상 ‘기회검진’ 새 지평
items.excerpt: 코어라인소프트의 흉부 CT 폐결절 AI 'AVIEW LCS'로 목 CT 판독에서 놓치기 쉬운 초기 폐암 병변을 검출한 연구가 Korean Journal of Radiology에 실렸다. 8만1794명 추적에서 폐암 확진자 123명의 과거 목 CT에 병변이 이미 찍혀 있었다.

items.title: [KIMES BUSAN 특별좌담회] 한·중·일 ‘혁신 의료기기 규제’ 3국 3색
items.excerpt: 의료 AI 기업 인허가 실무자와 중국·일본 규제 전문가가 MFDS·NMPA·PMDA 인허가 장벽과 K-의료 AI 솔루션의 해외 진출 전략을 짚은 좌담회.

items.title: 병원 AI 혁신의 명과 암…성과 뒤에 숨은 과제들
items.excerpt: IHF 세계병원대회에서 스탠퍼드 헬스케어(약 100개 AI 도구 운영, EHR 연결 LLM 'ChatEHR'), 휴스턴 메소디스트 등 병원 경영진이 AI 도입 성과와 실패 사례를 공유했다.

items.title: "AI 신약 개발·팬데믹 대응, 열쇠는 '데이터 공유와 협력'"
items.excerpt: EMA 종양학 과학자문관은 AI가 개입된 신약 개발을 평가할 때 유익성 입증과 데이터의 전이 가능성을 본다며 글로벌 규제 조화와 데이터 공유를 강조했다.

items.title: AI 도입하면 끝?…세계 병원들 "AI 성과를 숫자로 증명하라"
items.excerpt: 세계병원총회 세션에서 시더스사이나이·인도 릴라이언스재단병원·지멘스 헬시니어스 등이 병원 AI 도입 경험을 공유하며 업무시간 절감·환자안전 개선을 수치로 입증해야 한다고 강조했다.

items.title: Silent evaluation reveals context-dependent validity of automated metrics for AI-generated clinical messages
items.excerpt: A staged rollout of GPT-generated draft replies to patient portal messages among 30 primary care physicians (Sept 2023-Aug 2024) tested whether automated metrics reflect the drafts' real clinical utility.

items.title: GUARD-LGG: a glioma upfront AI-driven radiotherapy response decipher for lower-grade glioma
items.excerpt: GUARD-LGG, a machine learning model trained on 963 patients, predicts early radiotherapy response in lower-grade glioma before treatment begins.

items.title: Using AI to offer personalized health advice
items.excerpt: The use of AI tools in medicine is increasing. What health-advice technologies are on the horizon, and how should they be tested?

items.title: 'AI sandboxes' are all the rage. Advocates scramble to control their future
items.excerpt: STAT Health Tech: the groups vying to shape the rules that would govern state AI regulatory sandboxes for health care AI.
